description: A left heading column with a decorative 2x11 bar matrix, and a right 2-col grid of 6 stat cells whose hairlines merge. On the G3 dust->white gradient.

motion.counter: @number-flow/react counts to the final value on enter

matrixFill.note: 22 cells; even-index cells fill from the top, odd-index from the bottom. Ships at height:0% (the original’s rest/SSR state).

responsive.base: columns stack (flex-col); bar matrix HIDDEN (max-md:hidden); card grid is 2-col
responsive.md768: flex-row, left column md:w-1/3 max-w-342px, bar matrix visible

correctedClaims: CLONE_SPEC.md §4.5 states the right card grid collapses to a single 326px column at 390. That is WRONG — measured on the original at 390 it is `grid-template-columns: 175px 175px`. The grid is unconditionally 2-col.

CLONE_SPEC.md §4.5’s stats-section heights were computed from a line-height of 1.1 on the stat roles. The rendered line-height is 1 (the number-flow shadow root forces it), so those heights are wrong.
knownUpstreamDefects: A stray `hello` class sits on each cell’s bottom bracket.
